summary: Every legal call contains exactly two axis-aligned rectangles represented by eight scalar coordinates, so coordinate magnitude does not create a scalable operation-count workload.

workload_bound.source_constraint: The function contract always supplies exactly four bounded coordinates for rectangle A and four for rectangle B.

replacement_checks.evidence: The source performs two rectangle width-height products, four extrema operations for the overlap intervals, two zero clamps, one overlap product, and fixed addition/subtraction. This proves O(1) time and O(1) auxiliary space independently of coordinate magnitude.
Black-box real-test execution verifies every existing ordinary check without inspecting its definition; fixed-arity overlap arithmetic replaces synthetic coordinate-magnitude scaling.
